annotations.title: Instant Post-Checkout API Key & IDE Credential Redeemer

description: Verifies a completed Stripe Checkout session (`cs_...`) directly against Ariadne Nexus billing and deterministically returns the buyer’s live HMAC-signed `nexus_live_...` API key, monthly quota, and 1-click Cursor / VS Code / Claude Code installation links. Use when: a user has just completed payment at Stripe Checkout and wants to immediately claim and activate their `nexus_live_...` API key inside Claude, Cursor, VS Code, or an autonomous agent without waiting for email delivery. Do not use when: the user has not yet paid or needs a checkout link first (use provision_agent_key instead). Behavior: Free, read-only, deterministic verification and HMAC credential derivation ($0.00 USD; idempotent across repeated invocations for the same paid `cs_...` session ID).

email.description: Optional billing email address used during Stripe Checkout (required when re-redeeming sessions older than 24 hours).

session_id.description: Paid Stripe Checkout Session identifier starting with "cs_" (e.g., "cs_live_..." from the /billing/success redirect URL or Stripe receipt).

name: redeem_checkout_session

api_key.description: Live HMAC-signed Ariadne Nexus API key ("nexus_live_...").

deliverable_unlock_url.description: Direct URL to any unlocked closing certificate, CUSIP vault, or forensic workpaper.

error.description: Diagnostic message if session is unpaid or invalid.

ide_quick_install.description: Pre-authenticated 1-click Cursor, VS Code, and Claude Code CLI installation commands.

included_queries_per_month.description: Monthly included MCP and REST tool calls.

purchased_sku.description: Settled subscription tier or one-time institutional SKU.

status.description: HTTP-equivalent verification status code (200 on paid settlement, 402 if unpaid).

success.description: True when payment is verified and the live API key is issued.

title: Instant Post-Checkout API Key & IDE Credential Redeemer
